voicesLocationInvalid: The selected speech folder cannot be used. It may be a filesystem root, linked folder or restricted location. In Settings, choose a regular speech folder your user account can access.
voicesIntro: Install a voice, listen to a short sample and choose it for speech. Downloads start only when you ask; text is then spoken on your device.
voicesDependencySize: The size shown covers the model and model card only. The shared runtime and dependencies need additional space; their download sizes vary. Remove voices you no longer need.
voicesRuntimeConsent: The official Python 3.13.16 runtime will be installed for this user. A compatible existing installation is reused. If the installer is unavailable locally, about 29 MiB is downloaded and its pinned SHA-256 checked. No administrator access or PATH change is requested. Once the official installer starts, wait for it to finish; the app's Cancel button cannot interrupt this stage.
voicesRuntimeReady: Speech runtime ready. Choose a voice to install.
voicesRuntimeMissing: The speech runtime was not found. On Windows, install it with the button below. Conversion and Morse audio do not need it.
voicesCancelled: Operation cancelled. Verified files will be reused when you retry.
voicesStopping: Waiting for the previous speech operation to finish. If the official installer has started, let it complete.
voicesFailed: The operation could not finish. Check your connection, free space and access to the speech folder, then retry. Setup logs are in its .voice-tools folder. Models changed outside the manager are preserved.
voicesLicensePiper: Piper engine: GPL-3.0. Model terms are in its source card. The shared runtime runs as a separate process.
voicesLicenseApache: Code and model: Apache-2.0. License and acknowledgment files are kept in the voice pack.
voicesArabicLicense: Kareem speaks Jordanian Arabic. Its source model card does not explicitly state the dataset license; review the source terms before redistributing this pack.
voicesInstallConsent: Download this voice and its required shared dependencies? Leaving this page cancels the download. The first installation may take several minutes because of the dependencies.
voicesRemoveConsent: Only verified model and model-card files for this voice are removed. Other voices, the shared runtime, your settings and recordings are kept.
voicesRemoved: Voice removed. The shared runtime is kept for other voices.
voicesPhase_dependencies: Preparing shared speech components. The first installation may take several minutes…
voicesPhase_runtimeInstall: The official installer is running. Please wait for it to finish…
voicesPhase_preview: Generating and playing the sample on your device…
voicesPhase_remove: Verifying and removing this voice's files…
